title: The WGSL-only textures
blurb: A colour ramp as a `texture_1d<f32>`, two environment maps as a `texture_cube_array<f32>` picked by layer, a hand-written percentage-closer filter from `textureGatherCompare`, a `textureGather` of one channel from four texels, and a point light’s shadow as a `texture_depth_cube_array` (§36). None of them is supported yet by the GLSL backend (Rule 10.5), so each derives a capability (`texture1d`, `textureCubeArray`, `textureGather`) with a WGSL row and no GLSL row (Rule 10.3): this example runs on the Tint half of the gate alone. The argument order is the spec’s: the component first on a colour texture, none on a depth one, the layer after the coordinate, the reference after the layer.
